collegeFullAddress: Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyanagar, Sector 7, Nerul, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400706
collegeInfo: Ramrao Adik Institute of Technology (RAIT), established in 1983, is one of the oldest and most prestigious engineering colleges in Navi Mumbai. Accredited by NAAC and NBA, RAIT consistently ranks among the top private engineering institutes in Maharashtra for its disciplined academics, vibrant campus, innovative research ecosystem, and excellent placement record.

scholarships.amount: Partial or full tuition fee waiver
scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Awarded to students based on their academic performance (PCM marks in 12th standard/MHT-CET).
scholarships.applicationProcess: Automatically considered at admission, based on eligibility.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/SBC, minority, EWS, etc.) as per Maharashtra government norms.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply through MahaDBT scholarship portal after admission.

events.eventFullDescription: INNOVISION is RAIT’s annual technical festival, hosting national-level competitions in robotics, coding, electronics, paper presentations, IoT, and more. The event features workshops, expert talks, and showcases from leading tech companies.

HORIZON, RAIT’s inter-collegiate cultural fest, features music, dance, drama, art, fashion, and literary events, inviting participants and celebrities from across Mumbai. Night concerts and star guest appearances are highlights of the festival.

infrastructure.infraDescription: RAIT’s modern 13-acre campus includes state-of-the-art laboratories, smart classrooms, a large central library, fully-furnished hostels, on-campus cafeteria, gymnasium, and a sprawling sports complex. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled and offers medical and counseling facilities. Regular hackathons, project exhibitions, and industry-academia interactions are part of campus life.
